product.title: Monterey Bay Aquarium Admission Ticket

description.text: Visit the Monterey Bay Aquarium on Cannery Row with a skip-the-line admission ticket for all-day access. Explore kelp forest, open sea, and otter exhibits plus daily feedings and interpretive programs at one of the top aquariums on the Pacific Coast.

highlights: Skip-the-line admission to Monterey Bay Aquarium
All-day access to major exhibit galleries
See sea otters, jellyfish, sharks, and kelp forest displays
Located on historic Cannery Row waterfront

start.description: Enter at Monterey Bay Aquarium, 886 Cannery Row, Monterey, CA 93940 during opening hours.

end.description: Exit at the aquarium entrance when your visit concludes.

product.itinerarySummary: Visit the Monterey Bay Aquarium on Cannery Row with a skip-the-line admission ticket for all-day access.

itineraryItems.title: Monterey Bay Aquarium
itineraryItems.description: Enter the aquarium and explore main galleries at your own pace.

itineraryItems.title: Kelp Forest
itineraryItems.description: View the towering kelp forest exhibit and surrounding marine habitats.

itineraryItems.title: Open Sea
itineraryItems.description: Visit the open-ocean gallery featuring sharks, sardines, and pelagic species.

itineraryItems.title: Cannery Row
itineraryItems.description: Walk Cannery Row before or after your aquarium visit along the Monterey waterfront.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.answer: The planned duration is 2 to 4 hours.
